conflicts.fact: Wording in the Lesson 4 Observed section of Wanjiru's 8 m tank calculation, 8 x tan 37 = 6.03 m, tank height 7.5 m, which relates to the Lesson 8 statement
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 gives the same figures as Lesson 8 (6.03, 7.53, 7.5), so no real conflict; this entry is withdrawn for consistency with the fact sheet.

conflicts.fact: The Lesson 3 Learned section says Wanjiru's 37° goes with 53° 'at the top of her line of sight', while Lesson 5 uses complementary angles for the protractor scale reading
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 treats the complement as the angle at the top of the tank triangle; Lesson 5 treats it as the scale reading on the clinometer. Both uses are valid, so these do not truly conflict.
